about.title: About the project
about.intro: The Good Boy Foundation is dedicated to improving the lives of dogs in Žilina, Slovakia. We rescue abandoned, abused, and stray dogs, providing them with medical care, shelter, and the love they deserve. Our mission is to give these loyal companions a second chance at life by finding them a loving home. Beyond rescue and rehabilitation, we also promote responsible pet ownership and animal welfare through educational and community programs.
about.closing: Our work is made possible by the support of passionate volunteers, generous donors, and a community that deeply cares about animal welfare. We also organize spay and neuter initiatives to address the stray dog problem and ensure long-term impact. At the Good Boy Foundation, we believe every dog deserves a safe, loving home and a happy life. Join us and help us make a difference — whether through volunteering, donating, or adopting a furry friend. Together we can build a better future for the dogs of Žilina.
